description: Documentation for the Tolgee localization platform, the Tolgee CLI and the JavaScript, Android (Kotlin) and iOS SDKs, including task recipes written for AI coding agents.
rules: Android SDK: the Maven group is io.tolgee.mobile-kotlin-sdk with artifacts core and compose; initialize once with Tolgee.init { contentDelivery { url = ... } } in Application.onCreate().
Android SDK: the Content Delivery must use the 'Android SDK' (JSON) format; the SDK does not parse strings.xml from the CDN.
Android SDK: Compose helpers stringResource / pluralStringResource / stringArrayResource are imported from package io.tolgee, replacing androidx.compose.ui.res.
Android SDK: keys are Android resource entry names; keep strings.xml as the fallback and push it with the Tolgee CLI (format ANDROID_XML).

Android SDK: follow the installation pages under android-sdk/integrations (android-views, jetpack-compose) and android-sdk/migrate-existing-app for install and migration work; the Markdown index of all pages is https://docs.tolgee.io/llms.txt.
The Tolgee MCP server (https://app.tolgee.io/mcp/developer, header X-API-Key) can list projects, keys and translations and create or translate keys; never commit the API key.
